'''Civilian exploratory corps''' was an organization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] which commissioned the [[All Terrain Exploration and Survey Walker|AT-EST exploration walker]] to [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]].
